newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends lower in thinly-traded session.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends lower in thinly-traded session.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures ended weaker but rebounded off session lows on the close in thin dealings, traders said.
One trader noted commercials played both sides of the market as well as end-of-the-week profit taking.
E.D.F. Man sold 1.3 million bushels March wheat, Prudential sold 800,000 March wheat and Cargill sold 800,000 March wheat, he said. "Those were the big players in March," he said.
LFG bought one million bushels of March wheat, Chay Grain purchased about one million March, Cargill bought 500,000 March wheat and Benson Quinn bought 500,000 March wheat.
Concerns again were aired about the lack of snow cover and cold weather in parts of the HRW wheat belt but temperatures are expected to moderate a bit, he said.
KCBT wheat was 3-1/2 to four cents per bushel lower, with March down 3-3/4 cent at $4.11-3/4.
